about: Shared cases for the link rules (QR codes). Checked by selftest.html (validate.js) and by builder/server/tests/test_overrides.py (cave_overrides.py), so the Builder and the server always agree. qr = the master's and a page version's rule; override = a QR that differs by room (https only); normalised = what is published for an override. problem = what the by-room rule says is wrong (QA-12), qrProblem = what the master's rule says; both sides must give exactly these words. Invisible characters (U+0085, U+001C to U+001F, U+200B, U+FEFF) and other non-ASCII are refused the same way by both (QA-11).
